title: Final angular velocity
description: Essential: The response must provide the correct final expression for ω(T) in terms of λ, a, I, B₀, μ₀, and π.

title: Proportionality constant α
description: Essential: The response must correctly identify α as the vacuum permittivity ε₀.

title: Apply Faraday's Law
description: Important: The solution must use Faraday's law to find the induced azimuthal electric field E_θ(r) = -(r/2) dB/dt.

title: Torque from electric force
description: Important: The solution must calculate the torque on the cylindrical shell by integrating the force from the induced electric field on its surface charge.

title: Angular momentum conservation setup
description: Important: The solution must relate the change in mechanical angular momentum of the cylinder to the change in electromagnetic field angular momentum, or correctly integrate the torque equation.

title: Self-induced magnetic field
description: Important: The solution must account for the magnetic field produced by the rotating charged shell (via Ampère's law) in the final state and include it in the dynamics or conservation law.

title: Define EM momentum density
description: Optional: The solution for part (b) correctly expresses the Poynting vector or momentum density 𝒫 in terms of E and B for the given geometry.

title: Sign error in direction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answer for ω(T) or α has an incorrect sign relative to the defined coordinate system (e.g., missing the negative sign from Lenz's law or cross products).

title: Neglect self-field effect
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution finds ω = -(λa²/(2I))B₀, which omits the correction from the shell's own magnetic field.
